svg.title: Uno R3 and MPU6050 I2C Wiring

g.text: J1 is a logical connector. Pin order shown: VCC, SDA, SCL, GND. Connect Uno A4/SDA to SDA and A5/SCL to SCL; tie AD0 low for address 0x68.

g.desc: J1 is a logical connector. Pin order shown: VCC, SDA, SCL, GND. Connect Uno A4/SDA to SDA and A5/SCL to SCL; tie AD0 low for address 0x68.

g.text: This drawing assumes a breakout powered from 3.3 V with SDA/SCL pulled up to 3.3 V. Check the exact board and its pull-ups. Use a bidirectional level shifter if required; never apply Uno 5 V to bare MPU6050 pins. KiCad checks cover only this logical wiring; hardware is untested.
